assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a standalone architectural concept image for the website of the forthcoming Orangery at Les Surgut, a forest event venue. Input image 1 is the architectural and material identity reference. Preserve exactly the same building concept: one rectangular black steel and clear glass pavilion with a steep symmetrical gabled glass roof, surrounded by dense tall Siberian conifers, warm timber decking, sheer ivory fabric draped under roof slopes, delicate warm string lights and circular ring chandeliers. Refined natural editorial architectural photography, realistic texture, believable straight structural lines. Keep the scale, glazing proportions and simple construction recognizably identical to the reference. No text, logos, watermark, collage, people, fantasy architecture, tropical plants or additional buildings. One wide landscape image, approximately 16:9. This is a visualization of a planned venue, not documentation of an already-built interior. Primary request: show the INSIDE of this same pavilion in gentle daytime forest light, camera just inside the front entrance looking toward the rear glass wall through the central aisle. Two parallel long dining tables with ivory linen, understated white and cream flowers, clear glassware and natural wood chairs, matching the reference layout. The tall central gabled roof structure and forest visible through glass must dominate the composition; full interior view with generous depth and real proportions. Soft pale daylight, restrained warm pendant lights, fresh green forest, natural linen texture, relaxed welcoming atmosphere. Do not add ceilings or solid walls. Keep it airy and authentic.
